# Manx Sailings

Independent autumn timetable compilation, not live status or availability. Read metadata before answering.

- [Agent contract](https://marroccofella-ops.github.io/manx-sailings/AGENT.md)
- [Metadata](https://marroccofella-ops.github.io/manx-sailings/data/metadata.json)
- [Timetable JSON](https://marroccofella-ops.github.io/manx-sailings/data/timetable.json)
- [Timetable CSV](https://marroccofella-ops.github.io/manx-sailings/data/timetable.csv)
- [Plain travel notes](https://marroccofella-ops.github.io/manx-sailings/travel-notes.md)
- [Schema](https://marroccofella-ops.github.io/manx-sailings/data/timetable.schema.json)
- [Official status](https://www.steam-packet.com/sailing-status)
- [Official booking](https://commerce.steam-packet.com/)

No row is not a cancellation. Missing coverage is not no service. Sources, withheld rows, rights and null provenance fields are explained in metadata and AGENT.md.
